stem.text: A battery with negligible internal resistance is connected to three resistors, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram: a battery at the top with three resistors connected across it, one resistor labelled X in the upper branch and two resistors in the lower branch; a current of 0.30 A labelled on the left-hand wire.

stem.text: All three resistors have the same resistance.
The current in the battery is $0.30\,\text{A}$.
What is the current in resistor X?
